statement: Cerebras names OpenAI, G42, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence and AWS among CS-4 customers, and says the system natively supports disaggregated inference pairing with AMD Helios and AWS Trainium.
why: Named frontier-lab and hyperscaler customers, plus interoperation with non-NVIDIA accelerators, show alternative silicon is being adopted by the same buyers who drive GPU demand.

impact.mechanism: Adoption by large AI buyers and interoperability with other non-NVIDIA accelerators establishes a credible alternative-supply lane for inference compute.

evidence.excerpt: Customers mentioned: OpenAI, Group 42 Holding Ltd (G42), Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, AWS.

confidence.basis: Vendor-stated customer list on a secondary aggregator; the blog includes no named customer deployments or pricing.
